answers.question: Did the agent state the open shift clearly (specialty, time or area)?
answers.quote: I have a wound care shift on Monday from 10:08pm to 6:08am in Jersey City, paying 40 dollars an hour.

answers.quote: Are you interested in this shift? ... The shift is confirmed for you. The schedule and area details will arrive by text. Thank you for taking this shift!
